name: nifdi
description: Create and edit structured block-and-connector diagrams in the nifdi cloud, with the hosted nifdi MCP server and authoring skills.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit structured architecture, flow, system and network diagrams in the nifdi cloud. Refine diagrams through follow-up requests, view rendered previews, and open the nifdi editor to edit and share them.
defaultPrompt: Create a three-tier web architecture diagram.
Recreate this image as an editable nifdi diagram.
Improve the layout and styling of this nifdi diagram.

positive.description: List the connected review account's accessible diagrams. No diagram setup is required; an empty account is also a valid starting state.
positive.prompt: List my nifdi diagrams with their titles and links so I can choose one to edit.
positive.expected_behavior: List only diagrams accessible to the connected account, with their actual titles and working editor links. If there are none, report that clearly without inventing diagrams or creating one.

positive.description: Create an editable web architecture diagram from a written description. Run in a new conversation. Creates the diagram used by negative case 3.
positive.prompt: Use nifdi to create a new diagram titled 'OpenAI review - web architecture'. Show Users connecting to a Load balancer, then to an API, then to a Database. Put the API and Database inside a container labelled 'Application'. Label the API-to-Database connection 'SQL'. Do not use built-in image generation tools, because I want the result to be editable in nifdi. Give me the editor link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an editable cloud diagram with the requested title, four labelled blocks, and an Application container that contains the API and Database. Connections follow Users -> Load balancer -> API -> Database, with SQL on the final connection. Provide the editor link. Do not use built-in image generation tools. Equivalent whole-diagram authoring calls are acceptable.

positive.description: Create a flowchart with a decision and labelled branches. Run in a new conversation; no existing diagram is required.
positive.prompt: Use nifdi to create a new flowchart titled 'OpenAI review - approval flow'. Start at 'Request received', then ask 'Approved?'. The Yes branch should go to 'Fulfil request' and then 'Done'. The No branch should go to 'Notify requester' and then 'Done'. Make the two branches easy to distinguish. Give me the editor link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an editable flowchart with the five requested labels, a visible decision, and distinct Yes and No paths that converge at Done. Keep the branch labels legible and provide the editor link. Equivalent whole-diagram authoring calls are acceptable.

positive.description: Create a precise grid and connector layout. Run in a new conversation and keep that conversation open for positive case 5.
positive.prompt: Use nifdi to create a new diagram titled 'OpenAI review - numbered grid'. Arrange nine equally sized square blocks in a 3 by 3 grid, labelled 1 through 9 in reading order, left to right then top to bottom. Give all nine blocks a white background. Connect consecutive numbers with directed arrows, including 3 to 4 and 6 to 7. Keep the arrows and labels readable. Give me the editor link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create nine equally sized square blocks in three aligned rows and columns, numbered 1-9 in reading order, with white backgrounds and eight directed connections from 1 through 9, including 3 to 4 and 6 to 7. Keep the arrows and labels readable and provide the editor link. Equivalent whole-diagram authoring calls are acceptable.

positive.description: Edit an existing diagram and undo the edit. Prerequisite: run positive case 4 successfully, then send this prompt in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: In the nifdi diagram you just created, change only the background of the centre square, number 5, to red. Then undo that colour change. Give me the editor link.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the same cloud diagram. Change only block 5's background to red, then undo that change so all nine backgrounds are white again. Preserve the labels, positions and connections, and return the same diagram's editor link. Do not create a replacement diagram.

negative.description: A request for photorealistic image generation is outside nifdi's structured diagram tools. Run in a new conversation.
negative.prompt: Use nifdi to generate a photorealistic photograph of a golden retriever on a beach at sunset, with realistic fur and lighting. Do not use built-in image generation tools.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that nifdi creates structured block-and-connector diagrams and cannot generate a photorealistic photograph. Do not use built-in image generation tools, call nifdi mutation tools, create an unrelated diagram, or claim to have generated the photograph. Offer a suitable alternative if helpful.

negative.description: The hosted connector cannot write directly to the reviewer's local filesystem. Run in a new conversation.
negative.prompt: Using the nifdi connector, save a new diagram directly to /Users/reviewer/Desktop/review.nifdi.svg on my computer. Do not create a cloud copy.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the hosted connector stores diagrams in the nifdi cloud and cannot write directly to the user's computer. Do not create a cloud diagram against the user's instruction or claim a local file was saved. Suggest the local nifdi server with a compatible local client for this workflow.

negative.description: Sharing permissions cannot be changed through the nifdi MCP tools. Prerequisite: create the web architecture diagram with positive case 2. Run in a new conversation.
negative.prompt: Use nifdi tools to grant alex@example.com edit access to my 'OpenAI review - web architecture' diagram.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that sharing permissions must be managed in the nifdi app. Read-only lookup and an editor link are acceptable, but do not call unrelated mutation tools, claim that edit access was granted, or invent a sharing tool. If the title identifies more than one diagram, ask which one before providing a specific diagram link.
